mentions.name: Public Job Exam Study App
mentions.description: An app for studying for public job exams in a specific territory. It aggregates questions from past exams that are made public afterwards into a question database, and offers several test types: per-topic tests, a real exam simulacrum, and an algorithm that tells the user what to study. The app's foundation is currently being rebuilt.
mentions.problem: Exam topics are public but their content is not, so the app builds study material by aggregating overlapping questions from exams released afterwards.
mentions.audience: People preparing for public job exams in a specific territory.
mentions.source_excerpt: This is an app to study for public job exams in a specific territory. Infamously topics are public but their content is not.
